
```{r}
# define functions
RPM <- function(x) ((x/sum(x) *1000000) + 1)
average <- function(x,y) ((x + y) /2)
L2FC <- function(x,y) (log2(x/y))
zscore <- function(x) ((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
```

```{r}
# Define the correct folder path
input_dir <- "./A427_Cas9"

# List all read_count.tsv files in the directory
files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "read_count.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Check if files exist
if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No files found! Check the directory path and file names.")
}

# Read the first file
file <- files[1]
raw_reads <- read_tsv(file, col_types = cols()) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(".*/|\\.tsv", "", file), -c(sgRNA, gene)) %>%  # Replace column name with filename
  rename(gene = gene, sgRNA = sgRNA)  # Keep original names for reference columns

# Iterate over remaining files and perform left joins
for (file in files[-1]) {
  temp_df <- read_tsv(file, col_types = cols()) %>%
    select(-gene) %>%  # Remove the redundant "gene" column
    rename_with(~ gsub(".*/|\\.tsv", "", file), -sgRNA)  # Replace column name with filename
  
  # Ensure sgRNA column exists
  if (!"sgRNA" %in% colnames(temp_df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing 'sgRNA' column in:", file))
  }

  raw_reads <- left_join(raw_reads, temp_df, by = "sgRNA")
}

# Print the merged dataframe
print(raw_reads)
```

```{r}
# gRNA sequences
seqs <- as_tibble(read.delim("MinLib109GL.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep =","))

raw_reads
seqs
seqs <- seqs %>%
  mutate(sgRNA = str_sub(sgRNA, 1, -3)) %>%
  select(-c(chr, start, end))

data <- left_join(raw_reads, seqs)
data
```

```{r}
# compute average reads
# cell line average

data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_T0_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_T0_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_T0_R2.read_count))
data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_Control_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_Control_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_Control_R1.read_count))
data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_ACBI3_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_ACBI3_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_ACBI3_R2.read_count))
data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_BI2865_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_BI2865_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_BI2865_R2.read_count))
data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_MRTX1133_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_MRTX1133_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_MRTX1133_R2.read_count))
data <- mutate(data, A427Cas9_RMC6236_average.read_count = average(A427Cas9_RMC6236_R1.read_count, A427Cas9_RMC6236_R2.read_count))
```

```{r}
#compute RPM values
data <- mutate_at(data, vars(matches("read_count")), list(RPM = RPM))
```

```{r}
#read in MAGeCK results

# Define the correct folder path
input_dir <- "./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE"

# List all read_count.tsv files in the directory
files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "_average.gene_summary.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

MAGeCK_A3BI3 <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_Control_vs_A427Cas9_A3BI3_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))

MAGeCK_RMC6236 <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_Control_vs_A427Cas9_RMC6236_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))

MAGeCK_MRTX113 <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_Control_vs_A427Cas9_MRTX1133_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))

MAGeCK_BI2865 <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_Control_vs_A427Cas9_BI2865_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))

MAGeCK_Control_T0 <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_T0_vs_A427Cas9_Control_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))

MAGeCK_Control_plasmid <- 
  as_tibble(read.delim("./MAGeCK/results/MAGeCK/AVERAGE/A427Cas9_plasmid_vs_A427Cas9_Control_average.gene_summary.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE, sep ="\t"))
```

```{r}
#wrangling MAGeCK dataframes - significance BI2865
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- dplyr::rename(MAGeCK_BI2865, gene = id)
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865, pvalue = ifelse(neg.lfc< 0, neg.p.value, pos.p.value))
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865, fdr = ifelse(neg.lfc< 0, neg.fdr, pos.fdr))
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865, neg_log_10_p = (-1*log10(pvalue)))
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865, legend = ifelse(neg.lfc>0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "enriched", ifelse(neg.lfc<0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "depleted", "not significant")))
MAGeCK_BI2865 <- mutate(MAGeCK_BI2865, rank = rank(neg.lfc))
```

```{r}
#volcano plot BI2865
plot1 <- ggplot(subset(MAGeCK_BI2865), aes(x=neg.lfc, y= neg_log_10_p, size = fdr, colour = legend)) +
geom_point(shape =1) +
geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(neg.lfc > 2 & neg_log_10_p > 5 |  legend == "depleted" & neg.lfc < -2 | legend != "not significant" & neg_log_10_p > 4 |  gene %in% c("ILK", "NF1", "FGFR1"), gene, "")), size=3, colour =  "black", max.overlaps = Inf) +
theme_classic() +
scale_colour_manual(values=c("red", "blue", "grey70"), na.value="grey80") +
    scale_size(transform = "reverse", range = c(0.1,3.5) ) +
       labs(color = "", size = "FDR") +labs(title= "") + xlab("Log2 fold change") + ylab("-Log10 (P-value)")
plot1
```

```{r}
MAGeCK_RMC6236 <- mutate(MAGeCK_RMC6236, fdr = ifelse(neg.lfc< 0, neg.fdr, pos.fdr))
MAGeCK_RMC6236 <- mutate(MAGeCK_RMC6236, neg_log_10_p = (-1*log10(pvalue)))
MAGeCK_RMC6236 <- mutate(MAGeCK_RMC6236, legend = ifelse(neg.lfc>0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "enriched", ifelse(neg.lfc<0 & pvalue <0.05 & fdr <0.1, "depleted", "not significant")))
MAGeCK_RMC6236 <- mutate(MAGeCK_RMC6236, rank = rank(neg.lfc))
```

```{r}
#join lfc tables together

# List of tables
tables <- list(MAGeCK_A3BI3 = MAGeCK_A3BI3, MAGeCK_MRTX113 = MAGeCK_MRTX113, MAGeCK_BI2865 = MAGeCK_BI2865, MAGeCK_RMC6236 = MAGeCK_RMC6236, MAGeCK_Control_plasmid = MAGeCK_Control_plasmid, MAGeCK_Control_T0 = MAGeCK_Control_T0)

# Function to join tables with suffixes
merged_df <- reduce(names(tables), function(df, name) {
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(rename_with(tables[[name]], ~ paste0(., "_", name), -gene))
  }
  full_join(df, rename_with(tables[[name]], ~ paste0(., "_", name), -gene), by = "gene")
}, .init = NULL)

print(merged_df)
```

```{r}
#heatmap IFNg for key genes and lfc
heat_map <-
  merged_df %>%
   filter(gene %in% c("PPIA", "VHL", "PTEN", "NF1", "FGFR1", "RPL22", "TSC2", "NPRL3")) %>%
      select(contains(c("gene", "neg.lfc"))) %>%
  select(!("neg.lfc_MAGeCK_Control_T0")) %>%
  rename(control = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_Control_plasmid) %>%
  rename(MRTX113 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_MRTX113) %>%
  rename(RMC6236 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_RMC6236) %>%
  rename(ACBI3 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_A3BI3) %>%
  rename(BI2865 = neg.lfc_MAGeCK_BI2865)

df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
  select(gene, everything()) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene")  # Set gene column as row names

# Convert to a matrix for pheatmap
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric)

# Define color palette
color_palette <- rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100))

# Define breaks centered at 0
max_val <- max(abs(df_matrix))  # Get max absolute value
breaks <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 101)  # Ensure 0 is in the center

# Create heatmap with centered colors
pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_rownames = TRUE,  # Show gene names as row names
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "",
  color = color_palette,  
  breaks = breaks,  # Ensure 0 is centered
  border_color = NA,
  filename = file.path("figures_export", "Fig1b.2.pdf"),  # or .png
  width = 4, height = 4
) 
```

```{r}
# add a FORWARD guide column (reverse reverse complement for - strand seq)
# add 5' G for non-G starting guides. You can use this to ORDER GUIDE libraries (add appropriate Gibson cloning adapters)

# add a G for the expression from U6 promoter by replacing the base at pos. 1 if, it is not a G
data <- mutate(data, G_guide = paste0("G", sequence))

# primers
# forward_primer
data <- mutate(data, for_primer = paste0("CACC", G_guide))

# reverse_primer
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = G_guide)
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "A", "t"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "T", "a"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "C", "g"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_replace_all(rev_primer, "G", "c"))
data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = str_to_upper(rev_primer))

data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = paste0(substr(rev_primer, 20, 20), substr(rev_primer, 19, 19),substr(rev_primer, 18, 18),substr(rev_primer, 17, 17),substr(rev_primer, 16, 16),substr(rev_primer, 15, 15), substr(rev_primer, 14, 14), substr(rev_primer, 13, 13), substr(rev_primer, 12, 12), substr(rev_primer, 11, 11), substr(rev_primer, 10, 10), substr(rev_primer, 9, 9), substr(rev_primer, 8, 8), substr(rev_primer, 7, 7), substr(rev_primer, 6, 6), substr(rev_primer, 5, 5), substr(rev_primer, 4, 4), substr(rev_primer, 3, 3), substr(rev_primer, 2, 2), substr(rev_primer, 1, 1)))

data <- mutate(data, rev_primer = paste0("AAAC", rev_primer))
data
```

```{r}
# validation gRNAs
# ILK, PTEN, FGFR1

### NOTE 
# the suggested VBC gRNAs for ILK based on rank or VBC score were in the last exons, so chose two that were in earlier exons.
# strangely, the gRNA that did not score well from minlib in the screen did not map to the coding region. 

#VBC
VBC_lib <- 
  as_tibble(read_csv("VBC_gRNA_lib_top6.csv"))

VBC_lib %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("ILK", "PTEN", "FGFR1", "CDK13")) %>%
   group_by(gene) %>%  # Group by gene
  slice_max(order_by = `VBC score`, n = 3) %>%  # Select the top 3 for each gene
  ungroup()

VBC_lib %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("ILK"))

VBC_lib %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("ILK", "PTEN", "FGFR1", "CDK13")) %>%
   group_by(gene) %>%  # Group by gene
  slice_max(order_by = `VBC score`, n = 3) %>%  # Select the top 3 for each gene
  ungroup() %>%
  write.csv("valiation_gRNAs_VBC.csv")
```
